title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal: In this subject, students consider their career paths by clarifying their work objectives. In order to find their paths, students conduct industry and company research, and undertake self-analysis to understand their circumstances. In addition, students will acquire basic business and communication skills for job hunting.
advice: This class is provided for 3rd-year students. The overview is as follows: 1. Dialogue and opinion exchange with graduates 2. Explanation of summer internships 3. Explanation of qualification examinations 4. Career design Precautions The lectures described above are delivered as special lectures by invited graduates. Students are required to actively participate in class. The special lecture schedule is subject to change. Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
books: textbooks: None reference books: None reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II are courses for job hunting, and students will prepare for better employment. Students are supposed to take this course regardless of their advancement to graduate school or to employment. In addition, the material learned in this subject may be used as reference matter for job placement in the next year.
